title: Methodology Governance Record Chain (E → IR → SP → S → QR → PR)
intent: Drives one story through the governance chain. The kernel owns the order; every stage is proven by the gate that already owns its verdict (hooks/scripts/chain-gate.py), never by a keyword in a file. The run's identity is the story id it is created for (--slug S-005), so evidence is resolved for THAT story only.

stages.title: E: Research Experiment
stages.goal: The story's experiment references verify on this machine's trust ring.
actions: Create docs/experiments/E-*.md and run the measurement gate
Reference the approved ids from the story's experiment_refs

stages.title: IR: Implementation Readiness
stages.goal: Gate 1 holds for the sprint this story belongs to.
actions: The story names its sprint (SP-id); the sprint names its IR

stages.title: SP: Sprint Planning
stages.goal: The story's sprint record passes the schema check.
actions: Create docs/development/SP-*.md and list the story in it

stages.title: S: Story Execution & Dev
stages.goal: The story record's AC metadata, DoD and chain references hold.
actions: Implement the story within the verified scope
Move the story record to review (or done) once the work lands

stages.title: QR: Quality Review
stages.goal: The QR record that declares this story is APPROVED and coherent.
actions: Create the QR record and verify the Definition of Done
Approve it only when every DoD item is verified

stages.title: PR: Production Readiness
stages.goal: The PR record naming this story passes the schema check.
